jobs_results.title: Jr. Data Analyst (Pune)
jobs_results.description:
Job Summary

Analyze data from Zoho and other business systems to derive actionable insights for decision-making. Develop and maintain Zoho Dashboards to track business metrics, KPIs, and performance indicators. Use Zoho Analytics to gather, clean, and organize data from various sources, ensuring accuracy and consistency. Generate business insights and recommendations based on data trends, patterns, and analysis. Prepare and process data for further analysis using data prep techniques and tools. Create detailed reports and presentations that communicate key findings to stakeholders. Design and implement data models to support business intelligence initiatives and reporting needs. Work with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into actionable data reports. Utilize Zoho IoT for data integration and analysis from connected devices, sensors, and machines. Monitor the performance of dashboards and data models, ensuring their effectiveness and alignment with business goals. Provide ongoing support and troubleshooting for Zoho Analytics and dashboard-related issues.

Skills

- Strong proficiency in Zoho Analytics, with the ability to create and manage reports, dashboards, and visualizations.
- Experience with data preparation techniques to clean, format, and organize raw data for analysis.
- Hands-on experience with Zoho IoT, including data integration and analysis from connected devices.
- Solid understanding of business intelligence and data analytics principles.
- Strong ability to generate meaningful business insights from complex datasets.
- Proficiency in data visualization tools and techniques.
- Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, formulas, and macros.
- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work with large datasets and derive insights using statistical and analytical techniques.
- Excellent communication skills to present data insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Requirements

- Gender: Male/Female (open to both)
- Age: 22-30 years
- Experience: 2-4 years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field
- Education: Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or a related field

Other Expectations

- Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.
- High attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and consistency.
- Flexibility to adapt to changing business requirements and analytical needs.
- A proactive approach to identifying data gaps and recommending solutions.
- Robust time-management skills and the ability to handle multiple projects.

Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying. .
